sections.content:
The postposition *nélkül* (without) takes personal suffixes to mean 'without me, without you', etc.:
- **nélkülem** (without me)
- **nélküled** (without you)
- **nélküle** (without him/her)
- **nélkülünk** (without us)
- **nélkületek** (without you pl.)
- **nélkülük** (without them)

This is one of the most common postpositions in everyday spoken Hungarian, especially in imperatives and emotional expressions: *Ne indulj el nélkülem!* (Don't leave without me!).

items.spanish: Kérlek, várj meg, ne menj el nélkülem!
items.english: Please wait for me, don't leave without me!

items.spanish: Nélküled nagyon unalmas lett volna a tegnapi este.
items.english: Without you, yesterday evening would have been very boring.

items.spanish: A csapat nélküle is be tudta fejezni a feladatot.
items.english: The team was able to finish the task without him too.
